recipe.visualDefinition: A close-up portrait of three individuals seen through a glass surface covered in fine water droplets, creating a textured, diffused look. The color palette is warm and monochromatic with golden-brown tones, featuring large, 3D-beveled numeric typography at the top and italicized sans-serif text at the bottom.
coreVisualRelationships: Texture of water droplets obscuring the subjects' skin and hair
Triangular arrangement of three faces filling the lower two-thirds
Contrast between the flat, dark background and the illuminated faces
Heavy, metallic-textured display type anchoring the top composition
coreInvariants: Water droplet texture across the entire image plane
Direct, neutral eye contact from all subjects

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Three subjects in a tight, bust-up crop; one central and slightly lower, flanked by two others slightly higher.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, beveled numeric characters at the top center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the large top text, down to the central face, then outward to the flanking faces, ending at the bottom-right text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dark, textured space at the very top and between the subjects' heads.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm brown and ochre tones in the skin and lighting.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black in the clothing and background shadows.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Gold-bronze metallic sheen on the top typography.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with a focus on tonal range from deep shadows to warm highlights.

letterConstructionRules: Heavy 3D beveling with a top-down light source
Thick dark drop shadows to separate text from the textured background
Tight kerning with slight character overlap
characterSpecificRedesigns: Numbers feature rounded outer corners but sharp internal angles
Bottom text is heavily italicized with a blocky, uniform stroke weight
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme contrast between heavy 3D display numbers and clean, flat italicized secondary text.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight for the 3D bevel effect.
Matches the blocky, slanted feel of the secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A studio portrait of three women with warm lighting, seen through a glass pane covered in fine, dense water droplets. The overall tone is sepia and golden-brown. The background is dark and out of focus.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, 3D-beveled bronze-colored numbers at the top center with a heavy drop shadow. Add white, bold, italicized sans-serif text in the bottom right corner.

verificationChecks: Is the water droplet texture consistent across the faces?
Does the top text have a visible 3D bevel and shadow?
Is the color palette strictly warm/brown/black?
Is the bottom text italicized and placed in the lower right?

adjustableVariables: Depth of the 3D bevel on the display text
mustRedesign: Specific facial features to avoid likeness issues
Exact numeric sequence to avoid brand imitation
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the droplets don't obscure the eyes too much
Check that the 3D bevel lighting matches the scene lighting
Verify the bottom text is legible against the dark clothing
recipe.reuseFormula: Portrait through wet glass + warm monochromatic grading + beveled display type + italicized secondary type.
